Subject: Onsite workshop — room selection & AV runbook for Acme exec day

Hi Sophie / John,

Thanks for taking this on. We have an in-person executive workshop for Acme on Feb 23 (full day) with a follow-up half‑day on Feb 24. Approx headcount: 35 in-room, ~8 senior execs joining remotely at times for panels. Key asks:

- Main room that seats 40 comfortably, with an adjoining breakout area for 3–4 concurrent small groups.
- AV: two large displays (4K preferred) facing the room, a center PTZ camera with good pan/zoom for speaker framing, and a second wide-angle room camera for gallery shots.
- Audio: ceiling or tabletop beamforming mic array (or equivalent) + mixer with echo cancellation for Zoom Rooms.
- Bring a dedicated Zoom Rooms license/hardware or a room PC with Zoom installed; USB-C/HDMI input for two demo laptops simultaneously.
- Wired internet 1 Gbps for the room (static IP preferred) and an on-site wired fallback for demos.
- On-site AV tech for the full day; a 30–45 min rehearsal slot the day before (Feb 22) to run demos and lighting.
- Doors open for us at 07:30 on Feb 23; session start 09:00 — we’ll need setup access at 07:00.
- Access/parking instructions for ~6 Redwood staff and temporary badges for Acme visitors.

Attached is a short matrix of our equipment/demographic needs (Acme_room_needs.xlsx). Can you confirm which rooms fit the bill, an AV quote including on-site support hours, available rehearsal windows on Feb 22, and any constraints for bringing Redwood demo laptops on wired network? Also please include a floorplan PDF if possible.

Thanks — Marissa

Hi Marissa / John,

Appreciate the detail — we can support this. Two quick options that match your list:

1) Room A — "Boardroom + Breakout" (ground floor)
   - Capacity: 40 seated theater / 28 at boardroom-style tables + adjacent breakout foyer for 3 small groups
   - AV: 2 x 85" 4K displays, 1 x PTZ camera (USB 3.0 / HDMI out), ceiling mic array, Yamaha mixer with echo cancel, room PC pre-loaded with Zoom Rooms; 2x HDMI + 1x USB-C breakout box at lectern.
   - On-site AV tech: included 4 hours; additional hours $150/hr.
   - Internet: 1 Gbps dedicated VLAN; static IP available (we can allowlist Zoom IPs).

2) Room B — "Small Auditorium" (2nd floor)
   - Capacity: up to 120; has installed camera rig and house audio, better for larger keynote segments but breakout logistics are farther away.

Boardroom (Room A) better for workshops and exec-level conversations — it's quieter and has the breakout foyer adjacent.

We attached the venue_floorplan.pdf and a short AV spec sheet: https://venueworks.com/av-specs/roomA.

We can book a rehearsal window on Feb 22 between 15:30–17:00 or 17:30–19:00; on-site tech can start as early as 06:30 on Feb 23 for setup.

Estimated add-on costs for the full AV package if you need dedicated tech coverage all day on Feb 23 (beyond the included 4 hours): $150/hr. Shipping and storage of demo equipment is $75/day if you leave anything overnight.

Let me know if Room A looks good and whether you want the full-day tech coverage. If yes, I can send a firm quote and invoice to procurement.

Best,
Sophie Grant
